verdict.rationale: Pika's own Smart Resize app reframes photos and videos for different aspect ratios, and its Upscale app adds resolution to clips, so it covers in-platform format and resolution adaptation without an outside tool. However, no specific ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) or output video resolutions (1080p or above) are documented; the only stated 4K figure applies to Seedream images, not video. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported aspect ratios, documented video output resolution of 1080p or higher, export/encoding details, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding

citations.quote: Resize photos and videos for different aspect ratios with Pika Smart Resize. Use AI to reframe the subject and adapt the layout for each format.
Smart Resize: Reframe for any format with AI
Upscale: Add resolution to any image or video
